label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows directly into LDAP filter construction. While some character replacement occurs, the escaping scheme is incomplete and insufficient for LDAP injection prevention. Special LDAP operators (&, |, !, <, >, ,, +, [, ]) are not escaped, allowing potential injection attacks. Resolved sink value: filter = '(uid=' + user_input_escaped + ')' where unescaped operators remain exploitable.

evidence.note: User input flows to LDAP filter without complete escaping; operators &, |, !, <, >, ,, +, [] remain unmitigated
